codeReview.summary: Implementation covers planner-led delegation end-to-end for this feature: typed decomposition plans with dependency DAG and role routing/confidence, new planner delegation modes (suggest_only/approve_plan/auto_trusted/full_autonomous), delegation rationale events, failure cascading outcomes (retry/escalate/fail dependency), and persistence of plan/events into run artifacts and trace surfaces. Added tests exercise plan generation, mode behavior, failure cascading, trace persistence, and config validation for new modes.
